<!-- Please read https://docs.gitea.io/en-us/logging-configuration/#debugging-problems -->
<!-- In addition, if your problem relates to git commands set `RUN_MODE=dev` at the top of app.ini -->

## Description
1. Opening the label dropdown and selecting more than one label applies only one of the selected labels. Sometimes two, not consistent. So far never all selected labels.

2. Doing this several times adds the remaining labels, but in the action log / comments of the issue, only the first added label is displayed.

I didn't check in detail, but 2. makes me think this was introduced by #13304.
Another recent bug related to labels is #13688


## Screenshots
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7880552/101701099-236f9800-3a76-11eb-8ccb-1a417def6856.png)

body:
I confirm this issue for stable release binary 1.13.0 for Windows platform with MariaDB.

And, I was able to reproduce it on try.gitea.io too. See: https://try.gitea.io/TemplateOrg/TemplateRepo
It should add "bug" and "repoonly" labels, but is added only "repoonly".
Same in 1.13.1, It's blocking issue for our workflow. Is there a chance to complete intergration org wide labels into gitea?
